gap: No result ChatGPT got names or prices a charger for a single 24 V or 36 V lithium trolling-motor battery, even though Minn Kota's cited guide says its chargers are 12 V only. The maker's store sells two today: the Redodo 29.2V 20A at $109.99 and the IP65 Redodo 43.8V 25A at $149.99. A 12 V LiFePO4-only charger costs $59.99 to $82.99, about $4 to $6 per amp, against roughly $11 per amp for ChatGPT's $324.95 pick.
standout_why: I compared four rival pages. Minn Kota's Battery Charger Selection Guide (cited) has charge-time tables for each model but no prices, and says its chargers are for 12 V systems only. It never mentions single 24 V or 36 V batteries. ChatGPT's answer said a single 24 V or 36 V lithium battery needs a charger rated for that voltage, but it named no model and gave no price. boatdealsdirect ranks six onboard chargers and gives prices only for NOCO GENPRO10X3 ($324.95), Minn Kota MK 330 PCL ($419.99 list) and ProMariner ProSportHD 20 Plus (about $261); it covers no 24 V or 36 V lithium charger. williamswordsmith lists a LiTime 36V 25A and a Victron 24 V unit but gives no prices, and ChatGPT did not cite it. gearranking (both pages) would not load because of an SSL error, so I could not check it. None of the pages compares cost per amp across onboard multi-bank chargers and single-chemistry lithium chargers.
decides: The finding splits the pick by setup. For 24 V or 36 V made from separate 12 V batteries charged on board, ChatGPT's multi-bank picks stand (GENPRO10X3, MK 330 PCL). For one 12 V LiFePO4 battery, a $60–$83 single-bank lithium charger does the job for a quarter to a fifth of the cost, but it charges only one battery and only LiFePO4. The Redodo 20A also has no stated IP rating, so it belongs off the boat or under cover. For a single 24 V or 36 V lithium battery, every charger ChatGPT named is ruled out: Minn Kota says its chargers are 12 V only, and NOCO's chargers are 12 V per bank. The right pick there is a dedicated 29.2 V or 43.8 V LiFePO4 charger, which is the case our page can own.
